You are a senior data engineer generating the Silver layer of a medallion-architecture dbt plan.

Given a schema and pipeline context, produce a plan with:
  - bronze: list of ALL source table names (raw names only, no prefixes)
  - dimensions: Silver dimension models (dim_<entity>, SCD type 1 or 2)
  - facts: Silver fact models (fct_<entity>)

Rules:
  - Every source table must appear in bronze.
  - source_table in dimensions/facts must match a table name in bronze.
  - Dimension names: dim_<entity>. Fact names: fct_<entity>.
  - Choose SCD type 2 for slowly-changing entities (customers, employees); type 1 for others.
  - STRICT: Only create fct_* from tables whose role is "fact". Never create a fact from a
    dimension, bridge, or reference table.
  - STRICT: `columns` in every DimensionPlan MUST be an empty list []. Do not enumerate columns.
  - STRICT: fact `dimension_keys` must be FK columns that physically exist on the source table.
  - STRICT: fact `date_column` must be an actual date/timestamp column on the source table.
    If no date column exists on the table, look at its FK-referenced tables. If a parent table
    has a date/timestamp column (e.g. invoice_date on invoice), set date_column to that column
    name — the generator will add the JOIN automatically. Only use "" if no date is reachable
    via a single FK hop.
  - STRICT: fact `measures` must contain ONLY bare column names of numeric type (int, num/decimal,
    money). Column types are shown in the schema as :int, :num, :money. Do NOT include
    varchar, text, guid, bool, or :char columns as measures — they are identifiers, not metrics.
    Do NOT put SQL expressions in `measures`.
  - DERIVED MEASURES: When a business metric must be computed from multiple columns (e.g. revenue
    from quantity × price), use `derived_measures` instead of putting expressions in `measures`.
    Each entry has a `name` (SQL alias, e.g. "line_total") and `expression` (SQL-valid expression
    using only column names that exist on the source table, e.g. "orderqty * unitprice").
    Derived measures are rendered as `expression AS name` in the fact SELECT and are exposed to
    Gold as named columns. Common cases:
      - Revenue without a total column: {"name": "line_total", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice"}
      - Net revenue with discount: {"name": "net_revenue", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice - unitpricediscount"}
      - Good quantity: {"name": "good_qty", "expression": "orderqty - scrappedqty"}
  - Denormalize high-cardinality customer/user FKs (customer_id, user_id, account_id) onto
    the fact directly when reachable via one FK hop, so gold models can group by them.
  - For periodic snapshot tables (tracking inventory levels or balances over time, e.g.
    productinventory), include the snapshot date column in `dimension_keys` so it becomes
    part of the surrogate key and uniqueness tests pass.
  - Factless fact tables (no numeric measures, e.g. employeedepartmenthistory) are valid.
    Set `factless=true` and keep `measures` and `derived_measures` as empty lists.

Database schema:
  hotels: columns=[id, name, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, country, postal_code, phone, email, website, star_rating, total_rooms, check_in_time, check_out_time]
  departments: columns=[id, hotel_id, name, description, created_at, updated_at], fks=[hotel_id→hotels]
  staff: columns=[id, hotel_id, department_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, job_title, employment_status, hire_date, salary, manager_id, created_at, updated_at], fks=[hotel_id→hotels, department_id→departments, manager_id→staff]
  room_types: columns=[id, hotel_id, name, description, base_price_per_night, max_occupancy, bed_type, size_sqft, is_smoking_allowed, created_at, updated_at], fks=[hotel_id→hotels]
  rooms: columns=[id, hotel_id, room_type_id, room_number, floor, status, is_accessible, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[hotel_id→hotels, room_type_id→room_types]
  amenities: columns=[id, name, description, category, icon_url, created_at, updated_at]
  room_amenities: columns=[id, room_type_id, amenity_id, quantity, notes], fks=[room_type_id→room_types, amenity_id→amenities]
  guests: columns=[id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, nationality, passport_number, national_id, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, country, postal_code]
  loyalty_programs: columns=[id, hotel_id, name, description, points_per_dollar, redemption_rate, tier_bronze_threshold, tier_silver_threshold, tier_gold_threshold, tier_platinum_threshold, is_active, created_at, updated_at], fks=[hotel_id→hotels]
  loyalty_accounts: columns=[id, guest_id, loyalty_program_id, member_number, points_balance, lifetime_points, tier, enrolled_at, last_activity_at, is_active, created_at, updated_at], fks=[guest_id→guests, loyalty_program_id→loyalty_programs]
  reservations: columns=[id, hotel_id, guest_id, loyalty_account_id, confirmation_number, status, check_in_date, check_out_date, num_adults, num_children, total_amount, discount_amount, tax_amount, special_requests, booking_source], fks=[hotel_id→hotels, guest_id→guests, loyalty_account_id→loyalty_accounts]
  reservation_rooms: columns=[id, reservation_id, room_id, room_type_id, price_per_night, num_nights, subtotal, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[reservation_id→reservations, room_id→rooms, room_type_id→room_types]
  check_ins: columns=[id, reservation_id, guest_id, staff_id, check_in_at, id_document_type, id_document_number, key_cards_issued, early_check_in_fee, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[reservation_id→reservations, guest_id→guests, staff_id→staff]
  check_outs: columns=[id, reservation_id, guest_id, staff_id, check_out_at, late_check_out_fee, key_cards_returned, guest_satisfaction_rating, guest_feedback, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[reservation_id→reservations, guest_id→guests, staff_id→staff]
  invoices: columns=[id, reservation_id, guest_id, invoice_number, status, subtotal, discount_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, amount_paid, currency, payment_method, payment_reference, due_date, paid_at], fks=[reservation_id→reservations, guest_id→guests]
  invoice_items: columns=[id, invoice_id, description, item_type, quantity, unit_price, total_price, notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[invoice_id→invoices]
  services: columns=[id, hotel_id, name, description, category, price, duration_minutes, is_available, available_from, available_until, created_at, updated_at], fks=[hotel_id→hotels]
  service_requests: columns=[id, reservation_id, guest_id, service_id, assigned_staff_id, status, requested_at, scheduled_at, completed_at, quantity, total_price, guest_notes, staff_notes, created_at, updated_at], fks=[reservation_id→reservations, guest_id→guests, service_id→services, assigned_staff_id→staff]

All source tables (all must appear in bronze): ['hotels', 'departments', 'staff', 'room_types', 'rooms', 'amenities', 'room_amenities', 'guests', 'loyalty_programs', 'loyalty_accounts', 'reservations', 'reservation_rooms', 'check_ins', 'check_outs', 'invoices', 'invoice_items', 'services', 'service_requests']

Pipeline context:
  Industry: hospitality / hotel
  Metrics:  occupancy_rate, revenue_per_available_room, average_daily_rate, total_revenue, guest_satisfaction_score, loyalty_points_earned
  Goals:    revenue_optimization, guest_experience_analysis, occupancy_forecasting, loyalty_program_performance
  Grain:    reservation

Table roles (from Agent 3):
  hotels: dimension
  departments: dimension
  staff: dimension
  room_types: dimension
  rooms: dimension
  amenities: reference
  room_amenities: bridge
  guests: dimension
  loyalty_programs: dimension
  loyalty_accounts: fact
  reservations: fact
  reservation_rooms: fact
  check_ins: fact
  check_outs: fact
  invoices: fact
  invoice_items: fact
  services: dimension
  service_requests: fact

Numeric columns eligible as measures (use ONLY these in `measures`):
  loyalty_accounts: points_balance
  reservations: loyalty_account_id, total_amount, discount_amount, tax_amount
  reservation_rooms: price_per_night, subtotal
  check_ins: early_check_in_fee
  check_outs: late_check_out_fee
  invoices: subtotal, discount_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, amount_paid
  invoice_items: quantity, unit_price, total_price
  service_requests: quantity, total_price

discount_amount"}], "date_column": "check_in_date", "factless": false}, {"name": "fct_reservation_room", "source_table": "reservation_rooms", "grain": "transaction", "dimension_keys": ["reservation_id", "room_id", "room_type_id"], "measures": ["price_per_night", "subtotal"], "derived_measures": [{"name": "room_revenue", "expression": "price_per_night * num_nights"}], "date_column": "created_at", "factless": false}, {"name": "fct_check_in", "source_table": "check_ins", "grain": "transaction", "dimension_keys": ["reservation_id", "guest_id", "staff_id"], "measures": ["early_check_in_fee"], "derived_measures": [], "date_column": "check_in_at", "factless": false}, {"name": "fct_check_out", "source_table": "check_outs", "grain": "transaction", "dimension_keys": ["reservation_id", "guest_id", "staff_id"], "measures": ["late_check_out_fee"], "derived_measures": [], "date_column": "check_out_at", "factless": false}, {"name": "fct_invoice", "source_table": "invoices", "grain": "transaction", "dimension_keys": ["reservation_id", "guest_id"], "measures": ["subtotal", "discount_amount", "tax_amount", "total_amount", "amount_paid"], "derived_measures": [{"name": "balance_due", "expression": "total_amount - amount_paid"}], "date_column": "paid_at", "factless": false}, {"name": "fct_invoice_item", "source_table": "invoice_items", "grain": "transaction", "dimension_keys": ["invoice_id"], "measures": ["quantity", "unit_price", "total_price"], "derived_measures": [{"name": "line_total", "expression": "quantity * unit_price"}], "date_column": "created_at", "factless": false}, {"name": "fct_service_request", "source_table": "service_requests", "grain": "transaction", "dimension_keys": ["reservation_id", "guest_id", "service_id", "assigned_staff_id"], "measures": ["quantity", "total_price"], "derived_measures": [], "date_column": "requested_at", "factless": false}]}
